# 1 Enoch Chapter 58 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**58:1** And-I-began another parable concerning the-righteous and-elect.

**58:2** Blessed are-ye, the-righteous and-the-elect, for-glorious shall-be your-lot.

**58:3** And-the-righteous shall-be in-the-light of-the-sun, and-the-elect in-the-light of-eternal-life: the-days of-their-life shall-be-unending, and-the-days of-the-holy without-number.

**58:4** And-they-shall-seek the-light and-find righteousness with-the-Lord-of-Spirits: there-shall-be peace to-the-righteous in-the-name of-the-Eternal-Lord.

**58:5** And-after-this it-shall-be-said to-the-holy, in-heaven above: Seek-ye and-inquire regarding-the-secrets of-righteousness, the-lot of-faith; for-it-has-become-bright as-the-sun on-the-earth, and-the-darkness-has-passed-away.

**58:6** And-there-shall-be a-light that-never-ends, and-to-a-limit [of] days they-shall-not-come. For-the-darkness-has-been-previously destroyed, and-the-light established before-the-Lord-of-Spirits, and-the-light of-uprightness established for-ever-and-ever before-the-Lord-of-Spirits.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Ch. 58 opens the section on the blessings of the righteous. 'Light of eternal life' is a key phrase. The 'lot' of the righteous is the positive counterpart to the judgment of the wicked. 'Lord of Spirits' (Ge'ez 'Egzi'a Manafest) is the distinctive divine title of the Parables.*
